# Quick Reference: surveymixr Cheatsheet

This guide provides quick examples for the most common tasks in `surveymixr`.

## Installation

```r
# Install from CRAN (when available)
# install.packages("surveymixr")

# Or install from GitHub
devtools::install_github("siyangni/surveymixr")
```

## Basic Workflow

### 1. Load Package and Data

```r
library(surveymixr)
data(mcs_simulated)

# Verify data structure
head(mcs_simulated)
```

### 2. Fit GMM Model

**Basic continuous outcome:**

```r
# 3-class linear growth model
fit_3class <- gmm_survey(
  data      = mcs_simulated,
  id        = "id",
  time      = "age",
  outcome   = "selfcontrol",
  n_classes = 3,
  growth_model = "linear",
  starts    = 500,
  cores     = 4
)

summary(fit_3class)
```

**With survey design:**

```r
fit_3class_survey <- gmm_survey(
  data      = mcs_simulated,
  id        = "id",
  time      = "age",
  outcome   = "selfcontrol",
  n_classes = 3,
  growth_model = "linear",
  strata    = "stratum",    # Stratification
  cluster   = "cluster",    # PSU/cluster
  weights   = "weight",     # Sampling weights
  starts    = 500,
  cores     = 4
)
```

**Binary outcome:**

```r
fit_binary <- gmm_survey_binary(
  data    = mcs_simulated,
  id      = "id",
  time    = "age",
  outcome = "delinquency_bin",  # 0/1 variable
  n_classes = 3,
  starts  = 500
)
```

### 3. Model Selection

**Compare multiple models:**

```r
# Compare 1-5 class models
selection <- gmm_select(
  data      = mcs_simulated,
  id        = "id",
  time      = "age",
  outcome   = "selfcontrol",
  classes   = 1:5,
  criteria  = c("BIC", "entropy", "BLRT"),
  starts    = 200,
  cores     = 4
)

# View results
print(selection)
plot(selection)
```

### 4. Extract Class Assignments

```r
# Posterior probabilities
posterior_probs <- fit_3class@posterior_probs

# Most likely class
most_likely_class <- apply(posterior_probs, 1, which.max)

# Class proportions
table(most_likely_class)
```

### 5. Analyze Distal Outcomes (R3STEP)

**Create person-level data:**

```r
# Extract one row per individual
person_data <- mcs_simulated[!duplicated(mcs_simulated$id), ]
```

**Analyze distal outcome:**

```r
# Test if classes differ on academic achievement
r3_result <- r3step(
  gmm_object  = fit_3class_survey,
  distal_vars = "academic_achievement",
  data        = person_data,
  method      = "BCH"  # Recommended
)

summary(r3_result)
```

## Common Parameters

### Main Functions

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `data` | Data frame | `mcs_simulated` |
| `id` | Person identifier | `"id"` |
| `time` | Time variable | `"age"` |
| `outcome` | Outcome variable | `"selfcontrol"` |
| `n_classes` | Number of classes | `3` |
| `growth_model` | Type of growth | `"linear"`, `"quadratic"`, `"latent_basis"` |
| `starts` | Random starts | `500` (production), `200` (exploration) |
| `cores` | Parallelization | `4`, `detectCores() - 1` |

### Survey Design (Optional but Important)

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `strata` | Stratification variable |
| `cluster` | PSU/cluster variable |
| `weights` | Sampling weight variable |
